description: What to do if you are stopped by police or security at a checkpoint.

steps.text: Slow down, stay calm, and keep your hands visible.
Be polite. You are presumed innocent (s.36(5)); a stop is not an accusation.
If asked to search your phone, you may ask on what legal authority (s.37).
If you are asked to 'follow to the station', ask: 'Am I under arrest, and on what grounds?'
You may remain silent about allegations until you speak to a lawyer (s.35(2)).
Note names, numbers, and location. Call someone you trust if things escalate.
